text_block_list.text: One day, in the central courtyard――

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, another message from my manager.
Let's see... a quick photoshoot right after this?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's overlapping with training time?!
Why does this keep happening lately...
choice_data_list: You look busy... Are you doing all right?
You look busy... Are you doing all right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you... Thanks for the concern.
Well, it's what I chose to do, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the race is coming up soon,
so things might get pretty hectic...
choice_data_list: Let's focus on what's right in front of us first.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, you're right.
It wouldn't be funny if we ended up half-hearted and got nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
One thing at a time right in front of me...
All right, I'm fired up now. Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously? You're a lifesaver.
I can't be heading to a photoshoot looking like a zombie.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, feeling pumped up now.
I'll drink this and give my all in both the photoshoot and the race.
